page.overview:
What is Shao Kahn's Sword?

Shao Kahn's Sword, also called the Sword of Shao Kahn, is another deadly weapon of Shao Kahn the Konqueror. This cursed blade was introduced in the 20th episode of TV series Mortal Kombat: Conquest.

This ancient sword was forged out of Outworld steel by Shao Kahn and it possesses the same strength as the Emperor, thus it was used to slaughter many enemies and traitors alike in kombat, and in interrogation as well. The sword serves as the reminder of Shao Kahn's dominance and merciless nature.
